name: Can Gio food guide
summary: Order lẩu cá dứa on đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất, then walk to chợ hải sản Hàng Dương for live seafood beside bãi 30 tháng 4. The mangrove plates are the mudskipper salad, lá lìm kìm, ba khía with lá buôi, and straw-grilled duck at Vàm Sát. A breakfast bowl was not named. A 2026 price is Check on arrival.
body: The sit-down streets are đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất, in the old Cần Thạnh town, now xã Cần Giờ. Dân Việt, on 2 Oct 2022, puts lẩu cá dứa nấu măng chua there, with the simmered fish, tôm tích, and the shellfish. The market is separate: chợ hải sản Hàng Dương on đường Thạnh Thới, about 50 m from the sand in a Thanh Niên story of 11 Mar 2019. You point at a live animal and the stall cooks it, or you take a pan already on the fire.

Ho Chi Minh City is the long meal. Here the plates are mangrove and coast. VnExpress, on 22 Sep 2021, describes gỏi lá lìm kìm with fried cá bống sao. Dân Việt, on 28 Apr 2024, describes gỏi cá thòi lòi, and does not say how that fish is cooked. Khô cá dứa is the thing people carry home. Salt from the pans is the other thing people carry home. No bowl of salt was named.

Sài Gòn Giải Phóng, on 17 Feb 2014, says much of the coast is nghêu beds and that the silt from the Đồng Nai and the Soài Rạp is why the seafood grows fast and tastes sweet. It does not name a nghêu plate. A breakfast bowl was not named. Where an hour or a current price was not printed, it is Check on arrival.
specialtiesLead: Lẩu cá dứa and khô cá dứa come first. The mangrove plates, the fruit, and rượu mật ong rừng Sác follow.

sections.heading: Seafood
paragraphs: These are the seafood plates the newspapers name. Dân Việt also lists lẩu cá ngát, cá bóp, and cá mao with the other pots and does not print a separate method. A current price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Lau ca dua
spots.address: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất
spots.note: Lẩu cá dứa nấu măng chua is the hotpot Dân Việt calls a Cần Giờ specialty. The fish has a smooth fatty skin. The broth is a southern sour-sweet pot with bamboo shoot already in it. You add bean sprouts, eggplant, pineapple, spring onion, and ngổ, then eat the fish with nước mắm, chili, and a little bún. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ca dua kho
spots.address: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất
spots.note: Cá dứa kho is the same fish, simmered and eaten with rice. A diner in the Dân Việt town story calls the flesh firm and a little fatty. A recipe was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Kho ca dua
spots.note: Khô cá dứa is the dried sea catfish people carry out of Cần Giờ. Dân Việt, 28 Apr 2024, describes the one-sun fish: split, washed, salted at about 10 kg of fish to 1 kg of salt for about an hour, washed again, and dried for one sun. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng and Tuổi Trẻ both call it a specialty. Their counts do not match, and the 2016 prices do not match. A 2026 price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Tom tich
spots.note: Tôm tích, also written tôm tít, is the mantis shrimp Dân Việt calls a Cần Giờ specialty. The plate the story walks through is cháy tỏi, burnt garlic, on large animals. Thanh Niên names tôm tích among the three things sellers said visitors ask for at Hàng Dương, with ghẹ and ốc. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Tom
spots.nameVi: Tôm sú, tôm sắt, tôm đất
spots.note: Sài Gòn Giải Phóng calls tôm the seafood visitors liked most in 2014. Most of it is tôm sú, from the sea or from ponds. Tôm sắt has a hard shell. Tôm đất has a soft clear shell and chewy sweet meat. Tôm gạch son, the story says, is best around lunar months 3 and 4. A cook was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Oc len
spots.address: Hàng Dương, or the town streets
spots.note: Ốc len is a mangrove snail. Dân Việt names it on the town menu. Thanh Niên names ốc len xào dừa as a box at Hàng Dương, 700 g, and names ốc among the three things visitors ask for, with ghẹ and tôm tích. A coconut ratio was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Goi chua oc dun
spots.note: Gỏi chua ốc đụn is a sour snail salad Sài Gòn Giải Phóng names among the snail dishes visitors could find in Cần Giờ in 2014. A method beyond the name, a street, and a price were not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Oc giac
spots.note: Ốc giác is a snail Sài Gòn Giải Phóng names beside the other snail dishes. The story calls it chewy and crisp. A cook, a street, and a price were not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Oc huong
spots.address: Town streets in 2022. No street in 2014.
spots.note: Ốc hương biển hấp sả is sea snail steamed with lemongrass. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng says the snail has small spots and a clean sea sweetness. A diner in the Dân Việt town story ordered ốc hương and did not name a cook. Both stay. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Oc mo
spots.address: Hàng Dương in 2019. No street in 2014.
spots.note: Ốc mỡ is a snail two stories cook differently. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng names ốc mỡ xào me and calls it sweet and soft. A Thanh Niên caption at Hàng Dương says ốc mỡ rang me. Both cooks stay. A recipe was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: So huyet
spots.note: Sò huyết is the blood cockle on the town menu and among the live shellfish at Hàng Dương. Dân Việt names one cook, sò huyết la cót, and does not print the method. Thanh Niên lists sò among the animals you point at and the stall cooks. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Vop
spots.address: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất
spots.note: Vọp, which Dân Việt also writes dọp, is a shellfish a diner calls large and not too chewy, eaten with mỡ hành and peanuts. The story also shows vọp nướng. A species name was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Hau nuong
spots.address: Chợ hải sản Hàng Dương, đường Thạnh Thới
spots.note: Hàu nướng is grilled oyster. A diner in the Dân Việt town story lists hàu among the plates. Thanh Niên shows grilled oysters with cheese and with mỡ hành at Hàng Dương. A recipe was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ca duoi hap
spots.address: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất
spots.note: Cá đuối hấp hành is stingray steamed with onion. Dân Việt says diners also eat the fatty liver. The broth of a ray hotpot is a different plate. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Lau ca duoi
spots.address: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất
spots.note: Lẩu cá đuối is the stingray pot on the same town menu. Dân Việt lists it with the other fish pots, cooked with vegetables, sour bamboo, cần cà, or ngót. A diner ordered it. The story does not print a broth that belongs only to the ray. Steamed ray with onion is the other plate. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cua um
spots.address: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất
spots.note: Cua um chua ngọt is a sour-sweet crab braise Dân Việt names on the town menu. The same page prices cua hai da by the kilogram. It does not say the braise is that crab, and it does not print the method. Cua cúm, the mangrove crab in a 2014 story, is a different animal. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cua cum
spots.note: Cua cúm is a mangrove crab Sài Gòn Giải Phóng describes as like a crab, living mainly in the mangrove, with a black body and a rough shell, and firm, fragrant meat. A cook and a street were not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ghe
spots.address: Hàng Dương, or the town streets
spots.note: Ghẹ is the swimmer crab. Thanh Niên says sellers at Hàng Dương named it, with tôm tích and ốc, as what visitors ask for. Dân Việt names ghẹ nấu bầu on the town menu and does not print the method. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng, in 2014, says some crabs are red-pink and some are green, and that the meat is firmer in the last days of the lunar month. The price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Mangrove plates, fruit, and a drink
paragraphs: Dân Việt, on 28 Apr 2024, and VnExpress, on 22 Sep 2021, name the leaf, the mudskipper, the duck, and the mangrove crab. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng, on 17 Feb 2014, names the mango and the custard apple. A dessert sweet was not named.

spots.name: Goi ca thoi loi
spots.note: Gỏi cá thòi lòi trộn lá lìm kìm is the mudskipper salad Dân Việt calls a Cần Giờ specialty. The fish is a white goby that lives in the mangrove, climbs trees, and runs on the mud. The flesh is sweet, fragrant, and soft. The story prints the leaf and the sauce, and does not print how the fish is cooked. VnExpress describes a different leaf salad, with fried cá bống sao. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Goi la lim kim
spots.address: Eco parks. No gate was named.
spots.note: Gỏi lá lìm kìm is the mangrove-leaf salad VnExpress describes, served with cá bống sao fried crisp, or with dried fish. The leaf is also mixed with tôm thẻ. This is not the mudskipper salad. The leaf is a small watery vine. The taste changes with the rain and with the hour. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Canh la lim kim
spots.note: Canh lá lìm kìm is the everyday soup VnExpress makes with the same leaf, tôm, and tép. Do not add salt. The leaf is already salty, and the shrimp is sweet. A little seasoning and ground pepper finish it. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Canh chua ca khoai
spots.note: Canh chua cá khoai is a sour soup Dân Việt calls a Cần Giờ specialty, even while it says cá khoai lives mainly in central Vietnam. The fish is round and long, with soft translucent flesh and very fine bones. The soup uses pineapple, tamarind, tomato, bean sprouts, ngổ, and spring onion. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Vit nuoc man
spots.note: Vịt nước mặn Vàm Sát is a brackish-water duck Dân Việt calls a Cần Giờ specialty. People there say it is raised along the beach, feeds with the tide, and eats seafood, so the meat is firm, sweet, and low in fat. The cook the story calls best is nướng rơm, grilled in straw, with a pepper and lemongrass dip. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ca doi muoi hot
spots.note: Cá đối nổ muối hột is mullet buried in coarse salt and cooked by the heat of the salt, which pops in the pan. People in Cần Giờ also call the fish cá đối buôi. Dân Việt says this is the famous cook, rather than grilling. The flesh stays moist and smells of coarse salt and lemongrass. Eat it in rice paper with forest leaves. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Sam trung nuong
spots.note: Sam trứng nướng is grilled horseshoe crab with eggs. Dân Việt says people take the male off the female, clean the animal, and grill it on charcoal until cooked. They then shred the meat and the eggs with spring onion, garlic, chili, cilantro, and crushed peanuts. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Lau ba khia
spots.note: Lẩu ba khía lá buôi is a mangrove-crab hotpot. Dân Việt says ba khía is also made into mắm, and that the pot has a fatty, clean-sweet crab riêu. In Cần Giờ the leaf is lá buôi, also called rau bộ đội, nutty, and better the more thoroughly you cook it. The story ties the leaf to meals of the Rừng Sác special forces, then to ordinary home cooking. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dia sam
spots.note: Địa sâm is a Cần Giờ specialty in Dân Việt, fresh or dried. Fresh, the story says, is grilled, stir-fried, fried, or cooked as porridge. Dried, it is used to sweeten a cooking liquid. It is naturally sweet, and the story calls the cooking simple. It does not say whether địa sâm is a root or an animal. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ruou mat ong
spots.note: Rượu mật ong rừng Sác is the drink Dân Việt puts with the mudskipper salad. A recipe, a strength, a shop, and a price were not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Xoai cat
spots.note: Xoài cát Cần Giờ is the Hòa Lộc mango grown here. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng, 17 Feb 2014, calls it round, yellow, and cool-sweet, and different from the same variety elsewhere because of the soil and the care. That story prints 300 ha, of which 13.8 ha VietGAP, and 1,500 tons a year. Those are 2014 figures. The price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Mang cau
spots.note: Mãng cầu is the other fruit Sài Gòn Giải Phóng pairs with the mango. The fruit is not very large. It is chewy and sweet, with thick flesh, and a taste the story ties to sandy coastal soil. A hectare, a stall, and a price were not printed. The price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: Hàng Dương is the market by the sand. Duyên Hải and Tắc Xuất are the sit-down streets.

spots.name: Hang Duong seafood market
spots.address: Đường Thạnh Thới, xã Cần Giờ
spots.note: Thanh Niên, 11 Mar 2019, puts the market on đường Thạnh Thới in the old xã Long Hòa, beside bãi 30 tháng 4, about 50 m from the sand. You choose sò, ốc, cua, ghẹ, tôm, or mực, and the stall cooks it, or you take a pan already on the fire. That story prints a cook fee of 10,000 VND a kilogram for steaming and 30,000 for rang muối, cháy tỏi, xào dừa, xào bơ, xào me, nướng mỡ hành, nướng phô mai, and nướng mọi. VnExpress, updated 28 Feb 2025, names the same cooks plus hấp xả lá chanh, and says the cook-to-order cost is a few tens of thousands of đồng. Both stay. A busy day in the 2019 story meant a wait of about 30–40 minutes. One seller said she sold from about 7:00 until about 21:00, and that the seafood had come in that morning at Cầu Cảng. A market bylaw was not opened. The hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Duyen Hai and Tac Xuat
spots.nameVi: Đường Duyên Hải và đường Tắc Xuất
spots.address: Xã Cần Giờ, the old Cần Thạnh town
spots.note: Dân Việt, 2 Oct 2022, sends you along Duyên Hải and into Tắc Xuất toward the sea for lẩu cá dứa and tôm tích. A closing hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Can Gio food guide — lau ca dua and Hang Duong
seoDescription: Lẩu cá dứa on Duyên Hải and Tắc Xuất, and live seafood at Hàng Dương. Mangrove salads, ba khía, and one-sun khô cá dứa. A 2026 price is Check on arrival.
